events.title: Talent is available in 11 languages!
events.summary: Shadow Dancers, I am pleased to announce that the talents are available in 11 languages (En, Fr, De, It, Zh, Ko, Ja, Es, Pt, Ru, Pl) To have them, you can simply go in the option menu and select under "Talent Language". As I dont speak the Asian languages or russian/polish I can not be 100% sure it is grammaticaly correct, let me know if something is off about the translation. I am looking to see if I can change the language of the tutorial parchment. Some minor changes also have been updated!

events.title: First Demo Update
events.summary: Hello Shadow Dancers!I am pleased to announce a demo update. Here is a list of what has changed:Options added to the main menu: You can now access settings in both the pause and main menus.New Options:Voice Slider: You can finally mute Dracoulous while enjoying the rest of the sounds.Invert X/Y: Camera controls are now customizable.Camera Shake: Now optional (On/Off).Sensitivity Sliders: Fine-tune your controls.FPS: Range from 30 to 144.Main Menu: Added a new animation to bring the menu to life.
